Information
Passive: Toggle

"I am Speed" 

Passive

[Passive, True] Spacetime Manipulation - The user obtains Spacetime Manipulation.

[Passive, Toggle] Amplification and Thought Acceleration - The user regenerates Magicules x4 as fast. 8x as fast on mastery. The user gains +4 Learning and Mastery Points. Increase magic casting speed multiplier by 3, increase movement speed by 0.02 (0.04 with Mastery), increase attack speed by 0.3 (0.6 with Mastery)

Actives

[Active, Press] Cardinal Acceleration (Only a mode if you have Acceleration) - When used shifting, the user fires a powerful beam that deals 250 Flame Damage (350 when mastered) and melts blocks when it hits them.

When used normally, the user accelerators forward at high speeds dealing a massive amount of damage in a straight line. 350 (500 Flame Damage when mastered) + Attack Damage. 

[Active - Press] Parallel Existence - The user creates a Body Double Entity of themselves with sentience, their skills, and the same EP as the user.

[Active, Press] Encore - This is the same as Endorse' Encore, but it increases barriers by 90% (180% when mastered).

[Active, Press] Stockpile - This is the same, but it can store up to 225% unmastered and 500% when mastered, and deals bonus 50 Damage for every 100% over 200.

[Active, Press] Multidimensional Barrier - The user creates a Barrier with x4 HP (6x when mastered) as well as the benefits of Fault Field while the user has the Barrier Points.

[Active, Hold] Scorch Excitation - The user begins to massively increase the Magicules of all nearby allies in the area, they begin to gain massive strength, gaining a level of Ally Boost every 10 seconds, along with a level of insanity every fifteen seconds, and makes it so the user is able to boost their Magicules post their cap, increases it by 10% a second.

When shift used, this is used only on the user, and instead works at Ally Boosting yourself every 10 Seconds and gaining Insanity every 20 seconds, with your Magicules increasing by 15%.

Information
Passive: Toggle

"Eversleeping he stays, as his awakening is the end of humanity" 

Passive

[Passive, True] Digital Nature - The user becomes a Digital Nature. This means they are rendered immune to the effects of time.

[Passive, In-Slot] Beyond Jealousy - While in-slot, this skill allows you to randomly siphon Magicules and Aura from your target on hit. There is a 50% chance when you siphon Magicules and Aura to applied "Jealous" to their MP and AP bar. Preventing it from regenering in a similar fashion to Cook's Chaotic Fate.

[Passive Toggle] Envious Fortune - While toggled on, you passively have Luck X and will automatically remove effects from yourself (Based off the UltimateNightmareSkillConfig's "CthulhuEffectPurge": Config). for 1,000 MP.

Actives

[Active, Press] Absorption - This has several modes. The user can shift press between them.

Crushing Jealous - When this mode is selected, toggle the Crushing Jealousy on, and any target with higher MP or AP than you will gain "Envied" Effect. Targets with this suffer a small amount of MP or AP Drain (Random) on being damaged by the user. If the user's MP or AP is lower than the target, they will recieve the "Stolen Luck" effect. Stolen Luck will reduce the effected target's dodge chance and crit chance by 50% per level.

Inferior - When used, for the next 60 seconds, (100 when mastered), you become empowered, gaining increased Attack Damage and Armor, as you reflect the properties of Absorption. During the duration you have the Envious Mirror effect, all attacks become "Inferior" making them only capable of doing a maximum of 500 Damage.

Power Siphon - When pressed, the looked at target suffers Magicule and Aura Drain, losing 2.5% and applying a 1.5% Max MP and AP stunt with Jealous. now causes the target to have Chill.

[Active, Press] Fixation - This has several modes. The user can shift press between them.

Heat Death - Instantly kill any nearby mob without Thermal Nullification. Or any mob with less than 70% of your EP. Any target that survives is affected by Heat Death effect, which makes them take more Cold Damage and Spatial Damage.

Counter Freeze - When in-slot this mode causes the next attack of the target to render the attacker completely still and take the damage they'd take x3.

Eternal World - The user's Magicules and Aura are not expended while in Eternal World. The user's allies also obtain this benefit, and all regeneration (HP, SHP, MP and AP) is stopped in Eteneral World, but nothing can die either (Left at 1 HP). This effects all thins in a nearby 16x16 radius.

Complete Fixation - When used, it completely renders time still for 15 seconds.

[Active, Press] Devotion - This has several modes. The user can shift press between them.

Whiteout Absorb - The user stops the time in the area for 3 seconds, while time is stopped, it instantly kills any target without an Ultimate Skill. You regeneration is sealed for 5 seconds regardless;

If they possess an Ultimate Skill

And have less than 80% of the user's EP, they lose 80% of their HP and MP

And have less than 60% of the user's EP, they lose 60% of their HP and MP

And have less than 20% of the user's EP, they lose 40% of their HP and MP

If they have EP within 10% of the user, or above the user, they lose 20% of their HP and MP.

Absolute Stop - After using this, in a 12x12 area, the restoration of energy for all but yourself is impossible for 30 seconds.

Snow Shell - This is an altered version of Snow Crystal, when used the user gains x5 their HP as Barrier Points, and these Barrier Points cause the target to lose MP and AP when they hit you, until they're brokened.

Hysterical Festival - This is an evolved version of Dragon's Festival. The user begins to drain all nearby mobs for the next 8 seconds, the draining reduces their MP and AP by 5% per second, unless they have within 50% of your EP, resulting in them losing 2.5% per second instead. The user gains 10 seconds of resistance for every mob drained and the drained targets are inflicted with Jealous.

Information
Points to Master: 1000
Passive: Toggle

Passive

[Passive, In-Slot] Joy In Service - The user halves all Spiritual Damage taken. While the user has the Insanity Effect, any mobs killed will give the user 1 Sacrifice Point.

[Passive, Toggled] Insanity - The user gains Insanity 3.

[Passive, True] Greater Good (requires mastery) - The user's subordinates when willed by a source outside of the user, gives the user of this skill 15% of their EP.

Active

[Active, Press] Praise - The user will damage them selves for 10 HP and 20 SHP. This will generate 4 Sacrifice Points.

[Active, In-Slot] Carnage - The user's Sacrifice Points are used to deal Spiritual Damage on hit at a 2:1 Ratio. This as a configurable cap.

Information
Passive: Toggle

"Its poison. Deadly poison. So its a neurotoxin?" 

Passive

[Passive, Toggle] Thought Acceleration

[Passive, In-Slot] Detect Weakness - While this skill is in slot, entities you hit will progress the production of your Lethal Dose.

Actives

[Active, In-Slot] Bloody Bite - The user strikes at an enemy, spending some of their MP to inject them with their Poison. If the Detect Weakness is at 30% of less, this move only deals Physical and Spiritual Damage. (Halved by Abnormal Condition Resistance, reduced by 25% with Nullification). If Detect Weakness is at 50%, it infects them with Magicule Poisoning. If Detect Weakness is at 80%, it becomes Lethal Poison. If it is at 100%, it becomes Cursed Poison.

[Active, Held] Poison Refinement - While Held, this move will slowly drain the user's MP and begin producing 2.5% (5% on mastery) of the progress for your Lethal Dose a second.

[Active, Press] Deadly Domain - This can only be used when your Lethal Dose is at 100%. All Non-Spiritual Beings will take 500 SHP damage (1000 on mastery), and all Spiritual Lifeforms take 250 (500 on mastery) and your Lethal Dose is reduced to 0.

[Active, Press] Cursed Poison (Requires Mastery, Requires Learning) - The user can infect a target with Cursed Poison for 5 minutes.

Cursed Poison Effect

Cursed Poison is a Status Effect that deals both 25 HP and SHP damage per second each level. If you kill a entity while they are infected with Cursed Posion, you gain 10% more EP from it instead

The user cannot break the contract, but if they contracted target does, the user gains all of the benefits and no longer needs to uphold the bargain.

Points to Master: 1000
Passive: Toggle

Passive

[Passive, True] Wet Like Water - The user learns the Water and Ice Aspectual Magics.

[Passive, Toggled] Water Double

Active

[Active, Press] Mist - The user can produce a double of themselves, which has the same strength as the user. If the user dies while this skill is in use, they will instead take over the Mist Body.

[Active, Press] Rainfall - The area begins to rain, while it is raining, there will be random illusions of the user appear around. If they are hit, they will blow up, dealing 50 (100 when mastered) water damage.

[Active, Held] Slip - The user begins to slide across the surface of water, moving much faster.

Passive

When mastered, Demonic Power will turn the user into a Majin. This will take 15,000 Magicules to do, if you are already majin this will not take magicules

Active

When Pressed, apply strengthen III for 1 minute, this has no cooldown when the effect ends but cannot be disabled when pressed.
